thread.gist: Angry complaint: says he left an overcoat on an Aerlink aircraft in March and has had no reply despite four calls; reports website showing 'awaiting information' and was told by staff his AK150 to Rome is cancelled; is stranded at Gatwick late at night and requests immediate assistance (accommodation tonight), to be got to Rome, and return of his coat.

requests.ask: Provide somewhere to sleep tonight (overnight accommodation).
Get him to Rome (rebook / arrange transport to Rome).
Locate and return the camel-coloured overcoat left on an Aerlink aircraft in March (Selfridges label, initials in inside pocket).

most_recent_intention: I want somewhere to sleep tonight, I want to get to Rome, and I want my coat.

out_of_scope.item: Lost property (overcoat left on aircraft in March)

summary: Passenger Kenneth Braithwaite complains his AK150 to Rome was cancelled and he is stranded at Gatwick late at night; requests overnight accommodation and to be got to Rome. He also reports an overcoat left on an Aerlink aircraft in March which has not been returned despite multiple calls.
